game.name: Of Orcs And Men (Europe)
game.desc: In a world at war, the vast Empire of Man is attempting to extend its domination over the territories of the Orcs and Goblins, who are systematically persecuted, enslaved and massacred. In this role-playing game, you take charge of a powerful elite Orc soldier and a Goblin who has mastered the art of assassination and stealth. You've been assigned to carry out an extremely dangerous mission in enemy territory: to assassinate one man, just one... the Emperor himself. Make your way through a terribly hostile world to reach the goal of your quest. Level up, learn and develop powerful skills, and finally free your people from the yoke of the Empire!
